description.value: Nesters Market is a full-service neighbourhood supermarket operated by the Pattison Food Group, part of a BC-born chain founded in Whistler in 1987. The Summerland location stocks fresh produce, an in-store bakery, deli and bistro counter, pharmacy, and a broad natural and organic selection. For cyclists riding the Okanagan's wine-country routes, it is a well-stocked resupply point in the South Okanagan.
